Privacy Policy

How Astra handles your information

This policy describes the current Astra app and its shared account services. Some personal-reading features are introduced in an upcoming update; available functions depend on the app installed.

Astra works without an account. Your selected focus, practice progress, plans, decisions and notes stay on your device. Signing in does not upload or synchronize your journal. The app does not use advertising or analytics SDKs.

If you choose Sign in with Apple, Apple authenticates you and Supabase manages your shared Astra account and session. Apple may provide a name and an email address, including a private relay address. You do not need to disclose your real email address. The app stores session credentials in the iOS Keychain. You can also register or sign in using an email address and password through Supabase Auth, including an existing web account. Passwords are sent over TLS to Supabase and are not stored in Astra’s journal or logs. Password recovery, when email delivery is configured, uses a one-time code and a temporary memory-only session; it does not sign you into the app automatically.

After signing in, you can choose to connect the guest journal on this device to your account. This moves the local journal into that account’s local storage; it does not copy your notes to the server. You can instead keep the guest journal separate. Journals for different accounts are kept separately on the device.

You can optionally save your birth date in your account profile on Supabase. This separate calendar-date field is independent of the full birth-profile backup. The current practices and decisions do not depend on it. You can skip the date, edit it or remove it separately from your account and journal. User-written text and birth dates are not sent to analytics or diagnostic logs.

You can separately add an optional birth profile: calendar date, exact or unknown local time, resolved city, coordinates and historical IANA time zone. The app calculates astrology, numerology, Chinese zodiac, archetype readings, natal chart and transits on the device. Saved extended birth details are kept in a protected file for the current local owner. In app updates supporting profile restoration, signing in also privately backs up your completed birth date, known or unknown time, resolved city, coordinates and historical time zone to Supabase so your account can restore it after reinstalling or on another device. Existing local account profiles are backed up when connected. Raw birth inputs are not sent to OpenAI or other AI services. City search sends your city query to Apple Maps and requires no device location permission or street address. The full birth profile remains separate from the account's independent calendar birth date and from your local journal. Guest birth profiles are not automatically attached to an account. Only the authenticated owner can read or change the private backup.

Settings → Birth profile lets you edit or delete the current owner's birth inputs, draft and derived readings independently of the journal and account calendar birth date. Guest birth data is not automatically attached on sign-in; it stays in the guest workspace. Birth-profile deletion removes the protected local record and its private account backup when connected; offline removal is retained for retry. Shared-account deletion removes the private server backup and its local birth-profile file. Inputs erased before any backup existed cannot be recovered retroactively. Deleting a journal alone does not delete the separate birth profile. Device backups remain governed by Apple settings.

If you open the daily overview while signed in, Astra sends your selected focus identifier, app language and time zone to its Supabase backend. The server stores a dated editorial theme, action and reflection for your account and chosen focus. This content does not use your birth date or the text of your journal. Current overviews are cached on your device for offline reading; server snapshots are retained for up to 30 days.

Notifications are optional and require permission. If you enable them, Astra stores an APNs device token, random installation identifier, hashed installation proof, account association, app/environment, language, time zone, focus identifier and notification preferences on the server. The installation proof is kept in this device’s Keychain. The token is held in memory by the app and sent to the backend for delivery through Apple Push Notification service. It is not stored in the local journal or analytics.

Practice reminders and overview-ready notices use your chosen local time. Motivation is delivered at most once per local date in the existing 11:00–12:00 device-local window; no motivation time picker is used. A readiness notice is sent only after the daily overview exists. Notification copy does not include your notes, decisions or birth date. You can switch categories off in the app or revoke notification permission in system Settings.

Signing out requests revocation of the device binding; if offline, the app keeps a proof to retry after connectivity returns. Notifications already accepted by Apple cannot be recalled by the app. Registrations expire after 30 days without renewal; notification job records are kept for up to 30 days and temporary rate-limit buckets for up to two days. Shared-account deletion cascades the account’s associated overview, registration and notification-job data. Unowned installation revocation tombstones contain no journal or birth data and expire within 30 days.

Settings → Account lets you sign out or delete your account. Signing out returns to the separate guest journal. Deleting the shared Astra account removes the Auth account and associated server data across Astra apps, as explained before confirmation, and removes this account’s journal from this device. The account is shared with the earlier Astra app: deletion can also remove its associated server data. Other local journals are not removed. If an Apple identity is linked, its authorization is revoked as part of account deletion. Email-only account deletion does not require Apple. If deletion cannot be confirmed, the app reports an error and allows a retry.

Settings → Erase local journal removes only the journal currently open on this device. You can share an individual entry through the iOS share sheet; you choose the content and destination. The recipient’s privacy practices apply after sharing. Apple device backups are governed by your Apple settings and Apple’s privacy policy.

Apple processes in-app purchases, while Stripe processes existing web subscriptions. Astra recognizes verified eligible Apple or Stripe access; card details are not received by the iOS app. Apple transactions are refreshed through StoreKit and their signed proof is verified on the server. New signed-in purchases may include an account UUID token; explicit linking of an old purchase stores an account/original-transaction association. Stripe access uses the server-owned subscription status for the same shared Auth UUID. Manage billing through the provider where you subscribed. Deleting an Astra account does not itself cancel an Apple or Stripe subscription. Local guest Plus features remain independent of sign-in; server-backed personalized features require an account.

Optional personalized readings and Compass

When you open a personalized reading while signed in with a calculated local birth profile, Astra automatically sends derived profile facts (available signs, numerology, Chinese-zodiac and archetype), calculated transit-to-natal geometry, the chosen day/period, language, time zone and a profile fingerprint to Supabase and OpenAI. It does not automatically send raw birth date/time/place/coordinates or your journal. Derived facts are still personal data. A changed profile uses a separate registration and invalidates the previous profile’s materials. No separate permission prompt is shown in the app. You can stop profile-based requests and remove associated interpretations by deleting the birth profile in Settings → Birth profile; your journal remains separate.

Supabase stores an active profile registration/fingerprint and epoch, plus structured daily/weekly/monthly readings and supporting calculated facts for the account. Materials expire after 35 days and are physically cleaned by the existing worker and authenticated requests. Accessible daily history is only the current local week through today. Protected local caches are owner/profile/language/period scoped and bounded. Removing a local profile clears corresponding local readings and feedback and requests server deletion; when offline, an epoch-bound deletion request is retained for retry. Account deletion cascades the new server data. Operational backups follow the existing Supabase backup policy separately.

Compass sends only a question you explicitly submit, up to six bounded recent session messages and selected derived context. Astra does not persist its question/answer history to the materials database or journal. Technical usage rows contain model/token/cost/cache metadata without question/answer prose. OpenAI is requested to use store:false; this does not promise zero provider retention, and provider security/abuse-monitoring policies still apply. The use of third-party processing is described in this policy and the Terms of Use. Compass also identifies AI-generated content.

Accurate / Not accurate feedback is an editable subjective response saved locally for owner/material/version/day/section. It does not change calculated astronomy, complete practices, share data with friends or automatically train a model. Feedback is removed with the corresponding profile interpretations or account-local data.

If enabled, a personalized daily notification uses a short headline from an already saved reading for the same owner/profile/day/language/zone. Opening it resolves that specific material; it does not attach journal text or raw birth inputs. Daily readings are prepared when opened, so no new personal message is promised when the app has not prepared one. Existing editorial motivation remains separate for users without an active registered profile.

For privacy questions, contact anghel.developr90@gmail.com.

Earlier Astra versions

Earlier Astra apps may have retained generated profile or reading content and technical usage records under the shared account. Associated cloud records are removed by shared-account deletion, subject to applicable retention obligations and operational backups. Some earlier versions used Firebase Analytics for pseudonymous interaction events under their published policy; the current app does not include that SDK. Shared-account deletion does not itself identify previously collected pseudonymous analytics.

Service information

Service providers apply their own privacy and retention terms. See Supabase’s privacy policy, OpenAI’s privacy policy, Apple’s privacy policy and Stripe’s privacy policy. Astra does not sell your personal information.

Security, age and updates

Astra uses encrypted connections and protected local storage where supported. No system can guarantee absolute security. Astra is intended for adults and is not directed to children under 13. Material changes are published on this page.
